links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified responses to breast cancer prevention and screening questions
links.outcome: Reading ease and readability (Flesch Reading Ease, grade level) and word count of patient-facing responses
links.effect: Mean reading ease 46 original vs 70 simplified (P<.001); readability grade 13 vs 8.9 (P<.001); word count 193 vs 173 (P<.001); all 25 (100%) simplified responses met adequate reading ease vs 2 of 25 original (P<.001); only 2 of 25 (8%) simplified responses met sixth-grade readability
links.tradeoff: 2 of 25 simplified responses (8%) were not clinically appropriate (92% appropriate); potential to produce incorrect information necessitates physician oversight; most simplified responses still missed the sixth-grade target
links.quote: ChatGPT improved mean reading ease (original responses, 46 vs simplified responses, 70; P < .001) and readability (original, grade 13 vs simplified, grade 8.9; P < .001) and decreased word count (original, 193 vs simplified, 173; P < .001).

design_hint: reading-level constraint on patient-facing LLM output
